title: Any site key can lock another site out of its own page's audio
description: From the review of #76. The content hash is now deterministic from public page text. `_get_job` (cdk/lambdas/router/handler.py) returns 403 `site_mismatch` when the job's `site_id` differs from the caller's site. So any site-key holder can create the job for another site's public page first, and that site's readers get 403 from then on. Two sites legitimately narrating identical text hit the same wall. Decide whether reads should be allowed for any valid site key (the audio is derived from public text) with `site_id` used only for quota and billing, or whether the hash should be scoped per site.
